proposal.summary: An information disclosure in GitLab EE allowed other Group Owners to read the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination. Fixed in 16.2.5 and 16.3.1.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab EE: all versions from 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: allowed other Group Owners to see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

C.quote: see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm the fix in 16.2.5 and 16.3.1, verify public key read access is restricted to authorized roles only, and encourage users to upgrade to patched versions.

evidence_quotes.quote: An information disclosure issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 16.2 prior to 16.2.5, and 16.3 prior to 16.3.1
see the Public Key for a Google Cloud Logging audit event streaming destination, if configured.
Owners can now only write the key, not read it.
